title: 주택임대차계약증서의 확정일자 부여 및 정보제공에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
title_original: 주택임대차계약증서의 확정일자 부여 및 정보제공에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 6 (Applicants for Granting Fixed Dates, etc.)
(1) A person holding a housing lease contract may visit a fixed-date granting agency and apply for a fixed date.
(2) Any of the following persons may apply for an electronic fixed date through the Internet Registry Office: <Amended on June 27, 2016>
1. The lessor or lessee of the relevant housing;
2. An attorney-at-law or certified judicial scrivener, including a law firm, limited liability law firm, law partnership, judicial scrivener corporation, or limited liability judicial scrivener corporation (hereinafter referred to as a "qualified representative");
3. A licensed real estate agent who prepared the housing lease contract for the relevant housing.
(3) A qualified representative under paragraph (2) 2 shall complete registration of user information under Article 68 of the Registration of Real Estate Rules, and a licensed real estate agent under paragraph (2) 3 shall provide information on registration of establishment of the brokerage office under Article 9 of the Licensed Real Estate Agents Act.
(4) An applicant under paragraph (2) shall provide the following information: <Amended on November 26, 2020; May 27, 2021>
1. Individual: A certificate under Article 2, subparagraph 6 of the Electronic Signature Act capable of confirming the signer's real name and designated and publicly announced by the Minister of National Court Administration;
2. Corporation: An electronic certificate under the Commercial Registration Act.
(5) Public notice under paragraph (4) 1 shall be made by publication in the Official Gazette or posting on the Supreme Court website.
